{{Quote|The Sith infiltrators are no more. The galaxy's deadliest assassins. Feared by enemy and ally alike.|Servant One|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sith infiltrators''' were a group of [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] that were led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ekkage]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nomen Karr]] defeated Ekkage and her [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], who were then imprisoned in the depths of the [[Belsavis prison]].
